So we need to copy to archives/test_document.txt then rename inside archives. But rename inside archives requires moving within same directory? We can use mv to rename within archives. We can cd into archives, then mv test_document.txt final_document.txt. Then cd back. So steps:

- mkdir archives
- cd archives
- cp ../test_document.txt test_document.txt
- mv test_document.txt final_document.txt
- cd ..
